views.name: plot_basic_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  plot_sequence_number,
  survey_sequence_number,
  county_sequence_number,
  previous_plot_sequence_number,
  plot_inventory_year AS inventory_year,
  plot_state_code AS state_code,
  plot_state_code_name AS state_name,
  plot_survey_unit_code AS survey_unit_code,
  plot_county_code AS county_code,
  plot_phase_2_plot_number AS phase_2_plot_number,
  plot_status_code AS status_code,
  plot_status_code_name AS status_name,
  plot_nonsampled_reason_code AS nonsampled_reason_code,
  plot_nonsampled_reason_code_name AS nonsampled_reason_name,
  measurement_year,
  measurement_month,
  measurement_month_name,
  measurement_day,
  remeasurement_period,
  sample_kind_code,
  sample_kind_code_name,
  plot_design_code,
  horizontal_distance_to_improved_road_code AS distance_to_road_code,
  horizontal_distance_to_improved_road_code_name AS distance_to_road_name,
  water_on_plot_code,
  water_on_plot_code_name AS water_on_plot_name,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  elevation,
  type_of_annual_volume_growth_code AS annual_volume_growth_code,
  type_of_annual_volume_growth_code_name AS annual_volume_growth_name,
  type_of_annual_mortality_volume_code AS annual_mortality_volume_code,
  type_of_annual_mortality_volume_code_name AS annual_mortality_volume_name
FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot`
views.description: Normalized/cleaned plot-level dimension with canonical column names for joining and descriptive filters. Use this as the base plot relation for joins, mapping, and cohort selection. | Use for: Map plots (lat/lon) and join to strata or counties; Filter plots by measurement year, state, status, or sample kind; Aggregate elevation or remeasurement_period by state or survey unit

views.name: population_stratum_assign_bridge
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  stratum_assign_sequence_number,
  stratum_sequence_number,
  plot_sequence_number,
  state_code,
  inventory_year,
  survey_unit_code,
  county_code,
  phase_2_plot_number,
  region_or_station_code,
  evaluation_identifier,
  estimation_unit,
  stratum_code,
  stratum_assign_created_by,
  stratum_assign_created_date,
  stratum_assign_created_in_instance,
  stratum_assign_modified_by,
  stratum_assign_modified_date,
  stratum_assign_modified_in_instance
FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_stratum_assign`
views.description: Bridge relation exposing plot-to-stratum assignment records and assignment metadata. Use when you need to relate plots to strata, filter by inventory year, or analyze assignment counts and versions. | Use for: Count plots per stratum or estimation unit by inventory_year; Join with plot_basic_dim to get plot attributes for assigned strata; Identify most-recent assignment per plot using modified_date

views.name: plot_with_stratum_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  psa.stratum_assign_sequence_number,
  psa.stratum_sequence_number,
  psa.plot_sequence_number,
  psa.inventory_year AS assignment_inventory_year,
  psa.stratum_code,
  psa.estimation_unit,
  psa.region_or_station_code,
  psa.evaluation_identifier,
  psa.stratum_assign_created_date,
  psa.stratum_assign_modified_date,
  p.plot_sequence_number AS _plot_sequence_number,
  p.survey_sequence_number,
  p.county_sequence_number,
  p.plot_inventory_year AS plot_inventory_year,
  p.plot_state_code AS plot_state_code,
  p.plot_state_code_name AS plot_state_name,
  p.plot_survey_unit_code AS plot_survey_unit_code,
  p.plot_county_code AS plot_county_code,
  p.plot_phase_2_plot_number AS plot_phase_2_plot_number,
  p.plot_status_code AS plot_status_code,
  p.plot_status_code_name AS plot_status_name,
  p.measurement_year,
  p.latitude,
  p.longitude,
  p.elevation,
  p.remeasurement_period
FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_stratum_assign` AS psa
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot` AS p
ON psa.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
grain: one row per population_stratum_assign (assignment) with attached plot attributes
views.description: Denormalized join of plots to their stratum assignments. Keeps one row per assignment (bridge grain) and preserves both plot and assignment identifiers and descriptive attributes for downstream aggregation or filtering. | Use for: Spatial distribution of strata (map assignment lat/lon); Compare assignment_inventory_year to plot_inventory_year or measurement_year; Aggregate plot counts by stratum_code, estimation_unit, or state

views.name: plots_ranked_by_measurement_year
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  plot_sequence_number,
  measurement_year,
  measurement_month,
  measurement_day,
  -- construct a measurement_date where possible for ordering
  SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(CAST(measurement_year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(measurement_month, 1) AS STRING),2,'0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(measurement_day, 1) AS STRING),2,'0'))) AS measurement_date,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plot_sequence_number ORDER BY SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(CAST(measurement_year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(measurement_month, 1) AS STRING),2,'0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(measurement_day, 1) AS STRING),2,'0'))) DESC NULLS LAST) AS measurement_rank
FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot`
grain: one row per plot measurement (plot_sequence_number + original measurement row), ranked by recency
views.description: Per-plot ranking of measurements by measurement date (most recent first). Useful to pick latest measurement per plot or to filter top-K recent measurements per plot. Exposes rank so downstream queries can apply WHERE measurement_rank <= K. | Use for: Select latest measurement per plot (WHERE measurement_rank = 1); Find plots with multiple measurements and analyze recency distribution; Join latest measurements to stratum assignments

views.name: elevation_stats_by_state_surveyunit
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  plot_state_code AS state_code,
  plot_state_code_name AS state_name,
  plot_survey_unit_code AS survey_unit_code,
  COUNT(*) AS plot_count,
  MIN(elevation) AS min_elevation,
  MAX(elevation) AS max_elevation,
  AVG(elevation) AS avg_elevation,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(elevation, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS median_elevation_approx
FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot`
WHERE elevation IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY plot_state_code, plot_state_code_name, plot_survey_unit_code
views.description: Aggregated elevation statistics (count, min, max, avg, median_approx) per state and survey unit. Use for summary reports and as inputs to maps or stratified analyses. | Use for: Compare elevation distributions across states or survey units; Identify survey units with few sampled plots (low plot_count); Use median/avg elevation as covariates in ecological analyses
